capabilities: Convert Markdown notes to WeChat Official Account format
Preview rendered output in a sidebar panel in real time
Apply selectable templates with custom fonts, sizes, and backgrounds
Copy the styled result to the clipboard for pasting
Lock the preview to pause refreshes while editing
disambiguation: Not a general Markdown preview theme; its output is styled specifically for pasting into the WeChat Official Account editor.
extras: README is written in Simplified Chinese and states the interface supports only Simplified Chinese; the author solicits donations via WeChat Pay, Alipay, and Buy Me a Coffee.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn Markdown notes into the styled HTML format that the WeChat Official Account editor accepts.
summary: Markdown-to-WeChat converter that renders notes in a preview panel with templates, fonts, and one-click clipboard copy for the WeChat editor.
